title: Custom Data Commons agent configuration
description: Schema for this instance's agent-config.json (lives at the per-instance config bucket root). Mirrors the field surface of upstream config.json.example. Same schema is consumed in dev mode (UI panel) and prod mode (bucket file). One instance, one file — no overlay model across instances.

api_key.description: The Gemini API key for local development. Production deployments resolve the key from Secret Manager via the GEMINI_API_KEY_SECRET environment variable; never commit a real credential here.

api_base.description: Override for regional / vNext Gemini endpoints.

classify_model.description: Model used for the classify phase. The classifier runs at minimal thinking when the model name (its final path segment, for a resource path) starts with one of the prefixes in _MINIMAL_THINKING_MODEL_PREFIXES in config_model.py, and at low thinking otherwise.

discovery_model.description: Model used for the discovery phase, where entities and statistical variables are resolved from the MCP server.

synthesis_model.description: Model used for the synthesis phase, where the narrative answer is streamed from the gathered data.

follow_up_model.description: Model used for follow-up generation, which suggests follow-up questions grounded in the turn's digest, chart titles, and missing-data notes.

compaction_model.description: Model used for transcript compaction, which summarizes evicted turns when the conversation window exceeds its limit.

server_url.description: Where the agent talks MCP. In the sidecar deployment shape this is the in-task localhost endpoint; the network-MCP form is supported for split-service deployments.

enabled.description: Set false to run synthesis-only (no tool loop). Used for chat-only fallback when MCP is down.

_comment.description: Free-text annotation for maintainers. Ignored by the agent.

enabled.description: Set false to end every chat turn with a non-retryable chat_disabled error and report chat as disabled in the #runtime-config element of the HTML shell. The ENABLE_CHAT environment variable overrides this value when set.

unavailable_message.description: Message returned on chat turns while chat is disabled, and stamped into the #runtime-config element of the HTML shell. The UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE environment variable overrides this value when set.
unavailable_message.default: Due to high traffic, the application is currently unavailable.

_comment.description: Free-text annotation for maintainers. Ignored by the agent.

report.description: When the agent emits the turn debug report, which carries prompts and configuration details: off never emits it, flag emits it when the browser requests it with ?debug, and on always emits it and shows the debug entry without ?debug. A value that is not one of these turns the report off. The DEBUG_REPORT environment variable overrides this value when set.

_comment.description: Free-text annotation for maintainers. Ignored by the agent.

discovery_level.description: Reasoning budget for the discovery phase. Primary cost/latency dial.

synthesis_level.description: Reasoning budget for the final synthesizer. Primary cost/latency dial.

prompts.description: System prompts. Prompt bodies live in defaults/prompts/*.md, overridable in config/prompts/*.md and are loaded by the agent at startup; this object can override individual slots inline if desired. The agent renders {{instance.*}} placeholders against template_vars before sending to Gemini.

template_vars.description: Variables substituted into prompts when they are sent to Gemini. Keys are case-sensitive; reference them in prompts/*.md as {{instance.<key>}}. A placeholder with no matching key is left in the prompt verbatim rather than blanked. Keys beginning with _ are never substituted.

name.description: Display name of the instance (e.g. 'India', 'Karnataka', 'New Jersey').

region.description: Default geographic context for ambiguous queries.

states_term.description: Local term for sub-national administrative units ('states', 'districts', 'counties', 'provinces').

fiscal_year_start.description: Month/day of fiscal-year start (e.g. '04-01' for India, '01-01' for calendar-year states).

proxy_url.description: Legacy: where the agent itself binds. Container env (AGENT_PORT) is the source of truth in the target deployment; schema accepts this key for backward compatibility with upstream config.json.example.

$schema.description: Free-text annotation for maintainers. Ignored by the agent.

$comment.description: Free-text annotation for maintainers. Ignored by the agent.
